name: sun_times
description: Sunrise, sunset, solar noon, day length and civil, nautical and astronomical twilight for a date and a latitude/longitude, in an IANA time zone or a fixed UTC offset, by the NOAA solar calculator algorithm (Meeus' low-accuracy solar position, as in NOAA's spreadsheet and the astral library). Polar day and polar night are reported as such, not as errors. Also gives the Sun's declination and the equation of time at solar noon, and, for a given instant, the Sun's declination, apparent longitude, equation of time, elevation and azimuth. Sea-level horizon; times to the second or rounded to the minute.

timezone.description: IANA zone name such as Europe/Madrid, or UTC (default)

utc_offset.description: Fixed offset instead of a zone: "+02:00" or hours

datetime.description: ISO 8601 instant (a trailing Z or an offset; naive is UTC) for the Sun's position

catalog.source: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory solar calculator (spreadsheet formulas, after Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, chapters 25 and 28), as implemented by the astral library
